# Family Art Painting

> Family Art Painting Inc is a family-owned house painting company in Marlborough, Massachusetts, run by owners Leonardo Soares and Josilaine Moura. It paints homes inside and out for homeowners across Massachusetts and offers a free home visit and written estimate.

Key facts:

- Address: 46 Broad St, Marlborough, MA 01752, USA
- Phone, call or text: (774) 828-0102. Second line: (774) 670-3212
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 6 PM
- Service area: Marlborough and towns across Massachusetts
- Licensed and insured
- Estimates are free and sent by text message or email as a PDF
- The owners run every job themselves

## Services

- [Interior painting](https://family.escolats.com.br/#services): walls, ceilings and trim with washable finishes
- [Exterior painting](https://family.escolats.com.br/#services): siding and trim protected from New England winters and summer sun
- [Cabinet painting](https://family.escolats.com.br/#services): refresh kitchen cabinets without a full remodel
- [Door, window, gutter, stair, furniture and spray painting](https://family.escolats.com.br/#services)
- [Wallpaper removal](https://family.escolats.com.br/#services) without damaging the drywall
- [Drywall repair](https://family.escolats.com.br/#services) for holes, cracks and water stains
- [Minor carpentry repairs](https://family.escolats.com.br/#services) for rotted trim and loose siding
- [Power washing](https://family.escolats.com.br/#services) for siding, walkways and decks (warm season)
- [Post-construction cleaning](https://family.escolats.com.br/#services)
- [Commercial painting](https://family.escolats.com.br/#services) for offices and storefronts

Not offered: epoxy floors and wallpaper installation.

## How it works

- [Process](https://family.escolats.com.br/#process): reach out by form, call or text; free consultation at the home; the work is scheduled and painted
- [Frequently asked questions](https://family.escolats.com.br/#faq)
- [Request a free estimate](https://family.escolats.com.br/#contact)
